limits: Saved endpoints and root ledger reviewed; root GUI transitions not independently replayed.

Image-pixel line bands are appearance measures; not actual NSView frames, text baselines, CSS px or font identities. AX splitter values are reported as AX values independently.
First10 logical lines include blank line9; long wrapped paragraph beyond line10 not geometrically analyzed here.
All seven canvas sizes happen to match after direct decoding; sidebar-hidden/narrow states still treated separately.
